question: How does admin assign shared expenses?

sections.title: Assign or reassign one shared expense from its row
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to pick one participant directly on one shared-expense row.
items: Open Dashboard > Trip Shared > Expenses for the selected trip.
If assignee selectors are hidden, open the page menu and choose Show Assignees.
Use the Select assignee dropdown on the shared-expense row and choose the participant who should handle it.
Plantour assigns the shared expense immediately. If that expense was already assigned, changing the assignee works as a reassignment.
If you clear the assignee dropdown, Plantour unassigns that shared expense.

sections.title: Assign or unassign many shared expenses at once
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to work in bulk with one participant and many currently shown shared expenses.
items: Open the actions bar in the page header.
Choose the Trip participant target and select the participant you want.
Set the deadline-days field if you want Plantour to calculate an assignment deadline for the shared expenses you are about to assign.
Filter the list first if you want to limit which shared expenses are currently shown.
Click the page-level plus button to assign all currently shown not-targeted shared expenses to that participant.
Click the page-level minus button to unassign the currently shown targeted shared expenses from that participant.
sections.afterHtml: The shared-expense list updates its assignment status text so you can see whether each row is awaiting assignment, assigned, accepted, or rejected. You can also use the page menu to Show Assignments, Hide Assignments, or download the expenses PDF.
